## Checklist

- [ ] It keeps to the principles (https://alberto743.github.io/appjail/understand/principles/), or this description says
      which one it changes and why.
- [ ] The full suite passes on both guests: `tests/vm/test.sh` and `GUEST=ubuntu tests/vm/test.sh`.
- [ ] The documentation is updated in the same change: the concept page, the guide and the reference, and a decision
      page if a choice was made (`tests/vm/docs.sh` builds the site strictly).
- [ ] New files carry the SPDX header or are covered by `REUSE.toml`.
- [ ] No personal data (home paths, user names, host names, e-mail addresses, session links) in files or commit messages.
